text:
Diego Martinez: hi all! first day — quick snag. Okta shows me as active but I can't enroll passkey (keeps saying 'enrollment failed'). Also clicking the 1Password invite returns 'This link has expired'. Anyone know who to loop in?

Lina (IT): welcome Diego :wave: Can you paste the exact passkey error? For 1Password we usually resend from People Ops.

Diego Martinez: error popup says `Enrollment failed: request rejected (403)`. Happens after I choose the security key option. Browser is Chrome on macOS.

Kai T: that 403 on passkey often means device-trust policy didn't finish assigning your machine yet. Lina, could this be an MDM/profile timing issue?

Lina (IT): good catch Kai. Diego, did you complete the Okta device trust prompt earlier? If not, there should be a push to your phone. Also any chance you have another work alias like `d.martinez@redwood.dev`?

Diego Martinez: I only used diego.m@redwood.dev in the invite email. No phone push that I saw. 1Password invite was to diego.m@redwood.dev as well.

Sophie (People Ops): hey Diego — sorry about the expired 1Password link, our batch sent yesterday and a few timed out. I'll revoke the old and send a fresh invite to diego.m@redwood.dev now. Expect it in ~2 minutes.

IT Support Bot: Ticket created: #INC-2099 "New hire Diego - Okta passkey 403 + 1Password expired invite". Assigned -> Lina (IT). Priority: P2.

Lina (IT): thanks Sophie. Diego, I'm checking the Okta device-trust logs. I see an Okta profile but no enrolled device record. Two quick actions: 1) open the Okta app on your phone and accept any pending approvals; 2) try passkey enrollment again in an incognito window to avoid cached sessions.

Diego Martinez: tried incognito and restarted Chrome. Still fails at same step. No pending approval on my phone either.

Lina (IT): ok I'm going to force a reprovision and push a device-trust reset for your account. Also checking Google groups: sometimes Drive access fails if the account used for sharing is an alias. On our side the directory shows aliases `diego.m@redwood.dev` and `diego@redwood.dev`. If a folder was shared to diego@redwood.dev and your login is diego.m@redwood.dev, you'll see permission errors. I'll consolidate and request a propagation.

Kai T: adding Oncall-Directory in case group propagation job is needed.

Oncall-Directory: acknowledged. Standby for alias consolidation confirmation from Lina, then we'll run directory sync. ETA 10m after confirmation.

Sophie (People Ops): 1Password invite resent to diego.m@redwood.dev. If you don't see it, check Promotions/Spam. If still missing, reply here and I'll send a link manually.

Diego Martinez: got 1Password link, set up account and MFA. Thanks Sophie!

Lina (IT): I've forced the Okta device-trust reset and pushed a new enrollment packet. Try passkey enrollment again now.

Diego Martinez: trying... enrollment succeeded! Okta shows device trusted and I can sign in. Testing Drive access... initial folder shared by #team-data opens fine now.

Kai T: awesome. Diego, for repo access ping me or Marc L and include the repo names. We'll add you to the correct GitHub team.

Diego Martinez: will do, thanks everyone for the quick help :raised_hands: Appreciate the warm welcome!
